content: Embedded portfolio README guidance: lead with the problem and proof (demo, results table, test evidence), keep setup a single tested block, show one contested engineering decision with constraints/tradeoffs, state what was and was not verified, distinguish measured vs simulated data, avoid badge walls and scaffold boilerplate. Photon Circus repo standards add a README contract (what/why/state/scope/constraints/how to build-test), lifecycle labels, local CI entry point, and proportionality of verification.
